title: Binsight Multi-Segment Layout Profile (v1.1)
description: Configuration profile mapping multiple non-contiguous binary offsets to *.binsight.json schemas and Hardware Base Addresses

startOffset.description: Byte offset in the binary file where this segment begins (e.g. '0x0100')

hwBaseAddress.description: Hardware physical base address for this segment (e.g. '0x40010000')

schema.description: Relative or absolute file path (or built-in ID) of the *.binsight.json schema
